**Opening an old conversation is ~40% faster: 1,541 ms → 918 ms from click to messages on screen**, and the data sent drops **1.6 MB → 100 KB** (API) and **4.4 MB → 380 KB** (`/ai` page). Measured against a 300-message chat with saved tool outputs on the local dev server, median of 5 runs. In normal use hovering a thread already starts the load, so it feels faster than that.

## What's fixed

- **No more auto-reopening old chats.** The selected conversation was saved in a cookie for a year, and if nothing was selected the app opened your newest thread. The selection is now a session cookie, and no selection means a new, empty chat. This applies to both the AI page and the Ask Moneo panel. A chat you opened in the current browser session still resumes.
- **The Ask Moneo panel no longer blocks the app.** It used to be a modal dialog. It now opens beside the page (on wide screens the page makes room for it), so you can click, scroll and navigate the app with the panel open. Close it with the X or Esc. It also stopped reloading its conversation on every page change.
- **Old conversations load faster.** History now opens on the newest 30 messages instead of 100 ("Older messages" loads the rest). Each saved tool output is shown as a 2,000-character preview instead of being sent in full; the complete record is still kept in `chat_requests`.

## Testing
- Unit tests for the empty-selection rule and the tool-output preview were added or updated. `npm run lint` and `npm run build` pass.
- `npm test`: 14 tests fail in `lib/import/*` and `lib/ai/agent-runtime.test.ts`. They fail the same way on `main` before this change, so they are not caused by this PR.
- Checked in a browser with Playwright as the QA user: the panel opens on the empty state, the app behind it can be used while it is open, Esc closes it, and `/ai` with no session selection shows "New chat".

content.text:
All three fixes are done and the PR to `main` is open: https://github.com/indkhan/Moneo/pull/98. Opening an old conversation went from **1.54 s to 0.92 s** (click until the messages show). The data sent dropped from 1.6 MB to 100 KB, and the `/ai` page from 4.4 MB to 380 KB. I measured this on the local dev server with a 300-message test conversation, taking the middle of 5 runs.

What changed, one commit each:

1. **No more old chats opening on their own.** The last-opened chat was remembered for a year, and if nothing was saved the newest chat opened. Now it's only remembered until the browser is closed. A chat you opened in this browser session still comes back; otherwise the AI page and the Ask Moneo sidebar show the plain empty "New chat" view.
2. **The sidebar no longer blocks the app.** It now opens beside the page, and on wide screens the page shifts over to make room. You can click, scroll and move between pages with it open, and it closes with the X or Esc. It also no longer reloads the conversation every time you change page. I checked this in a real browser as the test user.
3. **Old chats load faster.** A chat now opens on its newest 30 messages instead of 100, and "Older messages" loads the rest. Each saved tool output is cut to its first 2,000 characters when shown in history. The full record is still saved in the database.

Validation: lint and the build pass. I added or updated unit tests for the new behaviour. `npm test` has 14 failures in the import code and in `lib/ai/agent-runtime.test.ts`, which I didn't change. The same 14 fail on `main` without my changes.

A few other things you should know:
- **Entire CLI hook:** its `prepare-commit-msg` hook hangs. As you said, I skipped the hooks on my own commit and push commands only; I didn't change the repo's settings.
- **Test data:** the test user's workspace still has the 300-message conversation I added for timing ("Perf seed: long old conversation"). `scripts/e2e-auth.mjs --reset` will clear it.
- **Leftover file:** I copied your `.env` into this worktree so the app could run. It's git-ignored.
